headline: Proposed ordinance amendments on natural communities, RTE species, specimen trees, and vegetation.
summary: The City Attorney has two proposed ordinance amendments on the agenda. ZA-27-03 covers natural communities, RTE species, and specimen trees, and a second amendment covers vegetation under BCO Chapter 29.
